title: Unique Umami Ethiopian Fish Stew
description: A cozy Ethiopian dish featuring charred fish, Thai sweet basil, and nuka pickle, all combined in a rich and savory stew. This pescatarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the fish and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the nuka pickle and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the fish stock and tomato paste, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 10 minutes.
Stir in the Thai sweet basil and cook for 1 minute.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
